records.title: Orion: A Collaborative Edge Inference Framework for Large Language Models Processing Multi-Sensor Data in UAV Swarms
records.protocol_domain9_text: Code, data, traces, or sufficient implementation details are available.
records.q9_rationale: The article provides substantial descriptive implementation detail, including dynamic-programming formulations and Algorithm 1 in Sections 3.1-3.3, a Python 3.13.5 simulation description and parameterized testbed in Section 4.1/Table 1, and repeated-run procedures in Sections 4.7-4.8. However, the Data Availability Statement says the original contributions are included in the article and directs further inquiries to the corresponding author; no public code, dataset, or trace repository was located on the publisher page. Therefore, the criterion is partially satisfied through descriptive implementation detail, while public artifact availability is not established.

implementation_evidence.item: Optimal LLM partitioning, device selection, memory constraints, communication-cost equations, dynamic-programming state transitions, and reconstruction procedure are described.
implementation_evidence.locator: Publisher article, Sections 3.1 and Algorithm 1, lines 262-323 and 324-370.

implementation_evidence.item: Adaptive sequence partitioning and predictive decoding mechanisms are specified, including the predictive module, validation, rollback, and latency formulation.
The evaluation implementation is identified as a Python 3.13.5 simulation framework, with emulated hardware, network ranges, models, sensor-log lengths, and baselines specified.
implementation_evidence.locator: Publisher article, Section 4.1 and Table 1, lines 561-591 and 844-872.

implementation_evidence.item: Repeated-run and robustness procedures are described using Monte Carlo simulations, independent trials, computation and communication perturbations, and sensitivity-analysis conditions.
The Data Availability Statement states that original contributions are included in the article and refers further inquiries to the corresponding author.
implementation_evidence.locator: Publisher article, Data Availability Statement, lines 705-707.

missing_implementation_items: Public code repository: not located on the publisher article page.
Public dataset or downloadable sensor-trace repository: not located on the publisher article page.
Executable scripts or configuration files sufficient to reproduce the simulation: not located on the publisher article page.
Raw simulation traces or machine-readable result files: not located on the publisher article page.
scope_limitations: Assessment is limited to the supplied protocol.md, the supplied C01 JSON, and the publisher HTML page specified in the brief.
The publisher HTML article was inspected; no separate public repository was located from that page.
This appraisal addresses only protocol domain 9 and does not re-appraise eligibility, public-artifact flags for other studies, or comparative performance effects.
unresolved_items: Whether the authors would provide code, data, or traces upon direct correspondence is unresolved.
Whether any repository exists outside the inspected publisher page is unresolved.

The 23 prior q9 labels were not inspected; a separate corpus-wide audit is required to determine whether they consistently distinguish public artifacts from sufficient descriptive implementation detail.
